About Me

A Bit About Me

An engineering student who enjoys building software, working with algorithms, and connecting microcontrollers to the real world.

I am Krishna Taneja, an engineering student. I like writing code, understanding how systems work under the hood, and building things that people can actually use.

Here is what I focus on:

  • Projects for College Use: I built the Lab Management System which is currently being deployed in our college lab, and Megatron to automate lab computer maintenance.
  • AI & Search Algorithms: In my AI/ML coursework, I implemented Depth-First Search (DFS) with backtracking to solve timetable scheduling clashes.
  • Hardware and Electronics: I write microcontroller code in C/C++, wire up circuits on breadboards, and connect sensors using serial protocols (UART, I2C, SPI).

I am currently looking for software engineering internships and technical roles where I can learn, contribute, and build useful projects.
